newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran state-run body invests in Kazakh shoe company.
newsitem.headline: Iran state-run body invests in Kazakh shoe company.

text.p: An Iranian state-run industrial body has bought a block of shares in Kazakhstan's shoe and leather producer AO Dzhambylkozhobuv, Iran's official news agency IRNA said on Friday.

It said the National Iranian Industries Organisation (NIIO) "purchased 75 percent of the workers' shares of the Kazakh...plant and talks are under way between the two sides for purchase of the remaining shares which belong to the Kazakh government."
It did not give the value of the deal.

The plant, in the southern Kazakh region of Dzhambyl, has an annual capacity to produce 20 million sq ft (2.3 million sq m) of leather and hide and five million shoes, the agency said. The factory is located in a town which has been renamed Taraz.
The NIIO is affiliated with Iran's Industry Ministry. Shares of some of the firms it controls have been sold on the Tehran stock market.
